title: Present to User
description: Deliver rich content to the user via Dashboard, PC overlay, Android overlay, or XR. Uses modality-specific rendering (text_card, chart_panel, diagram_panel, gltf_model) and may summarize rich content for overlay surfaces. Safety is enforced by the source capability, not by the presentation layer.

source.description: Origin of the presentation (e.g. autonomous_loop, user_request)

intent.description: Why this presentation is being created

content.description: Modality-specific content payload, including rich chart/diagram/3D data

targets.description: Delivery targets: dashboard, pc_overlay, android_overlay, xr_scene
